notes: Encoded ONLY from Ducane's own page; no Lennox or Allied Air system imported despite the Lennox-family listing. Style 2 is year-only: its 5th-position month letter has no text table on the page (chart/image only), so no month is encoded. Patterns are disjoint (10 digits vs 4 digits + letter + 5 digits), so no shape collision.

styles.era: 10-digit numeric serials, year + week at the end
styles.notes: Page form '41407203 28' normalized (space stripped). Page states year = 4th & 3rd from last positions and week = last 2 positions; on a 10-digit serial that is year [6,8] and week [8,10] in 0-based half-open ranges, and the page example decodes to 2003 week 28 under that reading.

Page form '4601 J19567' normalized (space stripped). Page positions 3rd & 4th = year (1-based), converted to [2,4]. Month is the 5th-position letter per the page, but no text month table appears on the page, so month is omitted pending the image pass.
